## Summary

- Update installed Sepo agent infrastructure from `@self-evolving/sepo` 0.3.0 to 0.3.1 using `self-evolving/repo@692c1a7711082bd9c00da7d468ac5260a84e21d9`.
- Sync the latest `.agent/` runtime, docs, tests, bundled model defaults, provider/runtime updates, follow-up intent handling, and dedicated `update-agent` route.
- Sync source `.github` agent assets that need to stay in lockstep with `.agent/` (actions, prompts, and workflows).

## Audit / preserved customizations

| Area | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| `.agent/` base runtime | Updated to 0.3.1. |
| Literature extensions in `.agent/` | Preserved target-specific literature update and Sepo site deployment CLIs/tests. |
| `.github` source agent assets | Updated existing source-owned actions, prompts, and workflows. |
| Literature-template `.github` assets | Preserved target-only literature workflows/prompts, deployment action, discussion-id resolver, Dependabot config, PR template, and bug/feature templates. |
| Issue templates | Replaced obsolete source-owned `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/install-sepo.yml` with latest `install-sepo.md`; added `ask-sepo.md`. |
| Root app/site files | Not changed. |

Memory/rubrics refs were checked before updating: `agent/memory` and `agent/rubrics` both exist, and existing `refs/agent-state/*` refs were left untouched.

## Validation

- `npm --prefix .agent ci` ✅ (completed with existing warnings: `acpx@0.6.1` wants Node >=22.12.0 while local Node is 20.18.1, and npm audit reports 2 high severity vulnerabilities)
- `npm --prefix .agent run build` ✅
- `npm --prefix .agent test` ✅ (`test:runtime`, `check:workflow`, `check:docs`, and `check:shell` all passed)
- `git diff --check` ✅
- `git diff --cached --check` ✅ before commit

## Post-merge notes

- Future scheduled/manual agent updates should use the dedicated `update-agent` route included here instead of a skill-backed updater.
- No memory or rubrics reinitialization is needed because the branches already exist.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #43 updates the installed Sepo agent infrastructure to `@self-evolving/sepo` 0.3.1.
- It brings in implicit follow-up intent handling, provider/model default updates, OIDC retry handling, review-context improvements, and a first-class `update-agent` route.
- The rubrics review passed, and one reviewer found the core authorization and routing design sound.
- The remaining current PR-diff issue is that the only unconditional `pull_request` workflow no longer validates the root Quartz site.

## Review
The agent runtime changes look well covered, but the workflow coverage change should be fixed before merge. The reviewers disagreed on whether removing root site validation is intentional; for this repository, there is no equivalent required PR-time site check left.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Restore PR-time Quartz site validation | BLOCKING | [`.github/workflows/test-scripts.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/1b2a1bab845c484921b75a726d86ed8abddb1201/.github/workflows/test-scripts.yml#L17) now only installs/tests `.agent`, removing root `npm ci`, `npm run check`, and `npm run build` from the unconditional PR workflow. `deploy.yml` is manual and site preview is conditional, so root site regressions can bypass required PR coverage. |
| Confirm model metadata footer default | WARNING | [`display_model`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/blob/1b2a1bab845c484921b75a726d86ed8abddb1201/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L32) now defaults to `true`, changing visible response footers unless repos opt out. This is documented, so it is a maintainer-awareness item rather than required branch work. |

## Progress
- Rubrics review passed with no rubric-specific findings.
- Posted one inline comment on `.github/workflows/test-scripts.yml` line 17.
- No replies added, no comments minimized, and no review threads resolved.
- Did not carry forward the proposed `quartz.config.yaml` comments-gating blocker: the current GitHub PR file list/diff does not include that path or the related site files.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Restore PR-time Quartz site validation</summary>

**Cause:** The PR replaces the root dependency install and Quartz `check`/`build` steps in `test-scripts.yml` with `.agent`-only checks. The remaining root validation workflows are either manual or conditional.

**Candidate solutions:** Restore the previous root `npm ci`, `npm run check`, and `npm run build` steps before the `.agent` checks, or add an equivalent required `pull_request` workflow for the root site.

**Comments:** One reviewer treated this as an intentional reusable-package tradeoff, but this target repository still needs PR-time Quartz validation unless maintainers explicitly move that contract elsewhere.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Confirm model metadata footer default</summary>

**Cause:** `run-agent-task` now defaults `display_model` to `true`, and docs state `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL=false` is the opt-out.

**Candidate solutions:** Keep as-is if the rollout is intentional, or switch the default back to opt-in if response-footer changes should require repository consent.

**Comments:** Not included in automation action items because the PR documents the new behavior.

</details>

FIX_PR: Restore equivalent root site validation in a required `pull_request` path; this is a concrete workflow change suitable for an automated fix-pr pass.

NEEDS_REWORK
